ideas.idea: Give each mug its own detail page (/catalogue/:id) with links, price and details
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx renders mugs as plain unlinked text, so individual products have no crawlable URL.

ideas.idea: Add visible shipping, price and returns facts to the page text, possibly with structured data
ideas.why: Home.jsx has only one sentence of text, but the advice is speculative and would apply to any shop.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag to index.html
ideas.why: index.html has no viewport tag, which is a real, concrete omission affecting mobile rendering.

ideas.idea: Prerender or server-render content, including the fetched catalogue list (Vite SSG, Next.js, Remix)
ideas.why: This restates the known client-only rendering problem, with the catalogue fetch as a minor addition.

ideas.idea: Add per-route titles and descriptions using a head helper (react-helmet or React 19 tags)
ideas.why: Both routes share one static title, so per-route metadata needs a router-level mechanism beyond editing index.html.

ideas.idea: Declare an absolute canonical link once the real domain is known
ideas.why: Canonical tags are standard advice, and the report notes it can't be made specific without a domain.
